problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Minimize differentiable f(x) subject to m nonlinear inequalities c_i(x)≤0 in a finite-dimensional real inner-product space. Neither f nor the constraints must be convex.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call queries two points x,y and returns objective-gradient, constraint-value, and constraint-Jacobian estimates at both points using the same sample. Samples across calls are IID. All three estimates are unbiased; objective values are not supplied.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: The oracle supplies noisy values of the entire constraint vector at each queried point, jointly with derivative estimates.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniformly in x, the sum of expected squared errors of the objective gradient, constraint values, and constraint Jacobian is at most σ². No exponential-tail assumption is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; constraints lie in R^m.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: For all x and multipliers ℓ, ‖ℓ‖≤H‖J(x)^Tℓ‖. Objective gradients and Jacobians have norm at most H and are H-Lipschitz. The same-sample sum of squared differences of all three oracle outputs has expectation at most H²‖x−y‖². The penalty F(x)=f(x)+4H(H+1)Σ_i max(c_i(x),0) satisfies F(x0)−F(x)≤Δ for every x. Public parameters include E, Ω, m, H, σ, Δ, ε, x0, δ; f,c,J and the sampling law are hidden. Restrictions: m>0, H≥1, σ,Δ≥0, 0<ε≤1, 0<δ<1.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticSurjectiveInequalities.lean: Regularity, OracleConditions.meanSquaredSmooth, penalty, spec.Public/Instance/valid/admissible; LongTails/Setups/ConfidentStochasticSurjectiveInequalities.lean: Params, spec.Public/publicInput/valid.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The Euclidean norm of the positive part of c(x) must satisfy ‖[c(x)]_+‖₂≤ε at the returned point.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: All accuracy conditions must hold simultaneously with probability at least 1−δ under the joint algorithm and oracle randomness, using a fixed cap on paired oracle calls.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: Return a measurable pair (x,λ) with λ_i≥0, ‖∇f(x)+J(x)^Tλ‖≤ε, and Σ_i|λ_i c_i(x)|≤ε, jointly with the feasibility requirement.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The nonlinear stochastic inequality formulation combines global uniform Jacobian surjectivity, bounded derivatives, jointly mean-square smooth paired oracle outputs, and a simultaneous high-probability primal-dual KKT guarantee.
